Also observed as some field line movement and dimming in SDO AIA 171/193.

cme.note: Bright CME visible to the NE in SOHO LASCO C2, C3 and GOES CCOR-1 imagery. This CME is not visible in STEREO A COR2 imagery due to a data gap. The source of this CME is an M3.0 flare from an unnumbered region just beyond the NE limb. It is possible this is the returning region 14507 (N04) which rotated off of the Earth-facing disk on 2026-08-21. This long duration flare is associated with visible moving/opening field lines in SDO/AIA 193, 171, 211, GOES SUVI 304 and 284 starting around 2026-09-02T19:00Z. It is also associated with a filament eruption (best seen in GOES SUVI 304 starting around 2026-09-02T19:08Z), EUV wave (best seen in SDO/AIA 193 starting around 2026-09-02T19:27Z), and post-eruptive arcades visible in SDO/AIA 193 and 171 starting around 2026-09-02T21:00Z. There may also be H-alpha emission visible within SOHO LASCO C2 & C3 imagery.
